method: Normal-speed browser playback with start/contact/release/end screenshots, plus complete 0.5-second filmstrips for market/spar and targeted entry frames. This is qualitative review, not frame-perfect human observation or mesh-contact certification.
milestone: Accept bounded authored observer release/settling; do not claim solved weight shift, foot planting, grasp contact or learned three-person action.

cases.observations: Greeting entry is less guarded. Pair reads as a greeting; foot glide and uncertain palm alignment persist.
Greeting remains readable with variable palm gap. No observer is present; not evidence of observer quality.
Guard/dodge source remains readable. Tight approach at 4.10–4.33 s has preexisting sphere overlap; not accepted as collision-free.
Purple initially faces the meeting and subtly settles. Cyan relaxes after first greeting; waiting raised foot and restricted whole-body attention remain awkward.
Both greetings and partner transfer are readable. Purple faces initial action; cyan relaxes after release. Cyan remains oriented away from part of later action, and source glide/lean persist.
Observer release carries through the partner transfer. Tight first entry at 2.30–2.60 s has preexisting sphere overlap; contact and feet remain variable.

exact_source_comparison.observation: Extended release arm eases down and upper body settles; source legs and active pair remain unchanged. Feet variant rejected as default.
